==Usage==
<pre>{{Email|author=|editor=|address=|source=|date=|legacy=1}}</pre>

Or, instead of {{Para|editor}}, can use {{Para|smt}} set to "1" if an email from the [[Wookieepedia:Social Media Team|SMT]] address.

==Example(s)==
Test, using [[:File:DanielJoseOlderEmailBibs.png]]: 
{{Email|author=Daniel José Older|editor=Spookywilloww|source=https://www.danieljoseolder.net/contact-1|date=2023|legacy=1}}

Test, using [[:File:AustinWintoryLegoFN-Email.png]]: 
{{Email|author=Austin Wintory|editor=Bonzane10|address=austin@austinwintory.com|source=https://www.austinwintory.com/contact|date=2024|legacy=1}}

Test, prototype for post-CT use:
{{Email|author=George Lucas|editor=NanoLuuke|address=example@mail.com|source=https://example.com|date=2030}}

{{Email|author=George Lucas|editor=NanoLuuke|date=2030}}
